title: Create a custom launcher
cancelTitle: Cancel: the launcher is not created
name: Name
writeName: Write the empty fields (name, description) with a coding agent
noCodingAgent: No coding agent is installed: install codex or claude.
promptPlaceholder: Review the last commit and list the risks.
folderPlaceholder: Empty: the root of the repository
folderOutside: The folder must be inside the repository.
descriptionPlaceholder: What this launcher does, on one or several lines.
writePrompt:
Write text for a custom launcher of a code editor, from what the person filled in below. Answer with one JSON object and nothing else, without a code block. The keys of the object are: {keys}. The key "name" is a short name of at most five words, starting with a verb, without a final period. The key "description" is one to three short sentences. Here is what the person filled in:

{description}
bothFilled: The name and the description are both filled. Empty the one that you want to write again.
badAnswer: The coding agent did not answer in the expected form. Try again.
saveTitle: Save the changes of the custom launcher
cancelEditTitle: Cancel: the launcher keeps its values
levelUserHint: The custom launcher shows in every workspace. A current work directory that is not empty is read from the root of each workspace.
levelWorkspaceHint: The custom launcher shows only in the workspace {name}.
